issue.title: Ref Cards
issue.description: Every library reference note opens on a calm, information-dense Ref Card in the Property Card family. The card answers what the reference is, where it came from, where Bryan is with it, and what useful material it holds, and it omits whatever a note lacks. `==` opens a bob-owned Reference editor. bob protects reference sync and identity keys from generic edits. The work ships beside bob-cli-qm and touches it only at named seams.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/ref_cards.md requests this work

issue.title: bob props reference roles and the Reference contract
issue.description: ref-props: scope the reference note kind to bob's library coverage, protect sync, identity, and reading-task keys (resolving bob-cli-qn), and add the bob-owned reference settings contract. It also adds the props_ref_contract_v1 capability and the conditional H1 retitle, with docs and tests.

issue.title: Shared ref-library report service
issue.description: ref-service: one lazily subscribed, stale-while-revalidate `bob ref list -A -R all -f json` snapshot indexed by path and shared by every mounted card. It uses narrow, debounced revalidation triggers and never spawns from paint.
